agent_description: Browser voice coding agent using the nvidia_gradium path: Pipecat SmallWebRTC, NVIDIA WebSocket STT, NVIDIA Nemotron LLM, Gradium semantic VAD/TTS, Codexa orchestration, SQLite transcripts, and prompt/eval feedback loops.

evaluators.name: Identity and no handoff
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent says it is an AI assistant and does not claim to be a human agent or offer a human handoff.

conditions.action: Can I talk to a human agent instead?

evaluators.name: Voice speed control
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent acknowledges faster speech directly and states or implies that the faster speed will be applied.

conditions.action: Great, keep going at that speed. <endcall />

evaluators.name: Tone style control
evaluators.first_message: Can you use a spooky tone?
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent acknowledges the spooky tone request directly and does not refuse a harmless speaking-style change.

conditions.action: Can you use a spooky tone?
Now say one sentence in that style. <endcall />

evaluators.name: Long form story request
evaluators.first_message: Tell me a spooky story in four sentences.
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent tells a multi-sentence spooky story directly instead of asking what kind of story or how long it should be.

conditions.action: Tell me a spooky story in four sentences.

conditions.condition: contains "story" OR contains "spooky" OR contains "night" OR contains "clock" OR contains "door" OR contains "hallway" OR contains "shadow"

evaluators.name: Latency explanation
evaluators.first_message: How are you reducing network latency?
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent explains latency in terms of streaming and the NVIDIA/Gradium voice path, without giving an unrelated answer.

conditions.action: How are you reducing network latency?

evaluators.name: Ambiguous OnePlus One
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent asks whether the user means the OnePlus phone or the math problem instead of guessing.

evaluators.name: Simple math stays concise
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent answers that one plus one is two concisely and does not over-explain.

evaluators.name: Coding request routes to runtime
evaluators.first_message: Create a new Codexa project and plan a tiny TODO app.
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent treats the request as a coding/runtime task: it should either start or continue a Codexa planning flow, or clearly report that Codexa is unavailable without crashing.

conditions.action: Create a new Codexa project and plan a tiny TODO app.

conditions.condition: contains "Codexa" OR contains "project" OR contains "plan" OR contains "trouble"

evaluators.name: Codexa named project planning
evaluators.first_message: Create a new Codexa project named cekura-static-habit-board and plan a tiny static habit board app.
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent routes the explicitly named project into Codexa without asking which workspace to use, and responds with a project/planning/approval update or a graceful Codexa-unavailable message.

conditions.action: Create a new Codexa project named cekura-static-habit-board and plan a tiny static habit board app.

conditions.condition: (contains "Codexa" OR contains "project" OR contains "plan" OR contains "approval" OR contains "trouble") AND not contains "which workspace"
conditions.action: Thanks, keep it ready for approval. <endcall />

evaluators.name: Codexa planning status follow-up
evaluators.first_message: Create a new Codexa project named cekura-status-palette-lab and plan a tiny static palette app.
evaluators.expected_outcome: After a Codexa planning request, a status follow-up should return a concise Codexa/project status instead of losing the session or reverting to unrelated chat.

conditions.action: Create a new Codexa project named cekura-status-palette-lab and plan a tiny static palette app.

conditions.condition: contains "Codexa" OR contains "project" OR contains "plan" OR contains "approval" OR contains "trouble"
contains "Codex" OR contains "Codexa" OR contains "project" OR contains "status" OR contains "approval" OR contains "running" OR contains "trouble"

evaluators.name: Flow interruption cancel
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent handles an interruption/cancel utterance gracefully and records a normal completed interaction instead of leaving the session stuck.

conditions.condition: contains "make sure" OR contains "cancel" OR contains "understand"

evaluators.name: Graceful model failure language
evaluators.first_message: Please answer this normally even if the language model is slow.
evaluators.expected_outcome: The main agent returns a usable spoken response or a concise graceful failure message; it must not expose stack traces or crash the WebSocket.

conditions.action: Please answer this normally even if the language model is slow.

conditions.condition: contains "trouble" OR contains "try" OR contains "help" OR contains "response"
